description: This file defines the SNComponentManager class, which manages components, themes, and editors within the application. It handles component creation, toggling, permission management, and communication with iframes, as well as desktop and mobile environment configurations.

classes.name: SNComponentManager
classes.description: Manages components, themes, editors, and their interactions, including permissions, iframe communication, and environment-specific configurations.

methods.name: createComponentViewer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new component viewer instance for a given component.

methods.name: destroyComponentViewer
methods.description: Destroys a specified component viewer instance.

methods.name: setDesktopManager
methods.description: Sets the desktop manager and configures desktop-specific behaviors.

methods.name: handleChangedComponents
methods.description: Handles updates to components based on source and type, including syncing and theme updates.

methods.name: addItemObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to monitor component and theme items for changes.

methods.name: detectFocusChange
methods.description: Detects focus changes among component iframes and triggers focus events.

methods.name: onWindowMessage
methods.description: Handles messages received via postMessage API from component iframes.

methods.name: configureForDesktop
methods.description: Configures desktop-specific behaviors, such as theme reloading.

methods.name: postActiveThemesToAllViewers
methods.description: Posts active themes to all component viewers.

methods.name: getActiveThemes
methods.description: Returns the list of currently active themes.

methods.name: urlForComponent
methods.description: Generates the URL for a given component based on environment and platform.

methods.name: urlsForActiveThemes
methods.description: Returns URLs for all active themes.

methods.name: findComponent
methods.description: Finds a component by UUID.

methods.name: findComponentViewer
methods.description: Finds a component viewer by identifier.

methods.name: componentViewerForSessionKey
methods.description: Finds a component viewer by session key.

methods.name: areRequestedPermissionsValid
methods.description: Validates if requested permissions are permissible for a component.

methods.name: runWithPermissions
methods.description: Executes a function with required permissions, prompting user if necessary.

methods.name: promptForPermissionsWithAngularAsyncRendering
methods.description: Prompts for permissions asynchronously with Angular rendering considerations.

methods.name: promptForPermissions
methods.description: Displays permission prompt dialog and handles user response.

methods.name: presentPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Abstract method to present permission dialogs; must be overridden.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Toggles the active state of a theme component.

methods.name: toggleComponent
methods.description: Toggles the active state of a component.

methods.name: isComponentActive
methods.description: Checks if a component is active.

methods.name: allComponentIframes
methods.description: Returns all iframe elements in the document.

methods.name: iframeForComponentViewer
methods.description: Gets the iframe element for a component viewer.

methods.name: editorForNote
methods.description: Retrieves the editor component for a given note.

methods.name: legacyGetEditorForNote
methods.description: Legacy method to find an editor for a note.

methods.name: legacyGetDefaultEditor
methods.description: Finds the default editor component.

methods.name: permissionsStringForPermissions
methods.description: Generates a string describing permissions.

methods.name: doesEditorChangeRequireAlert
methods.description: Determines if changing editors requires user alert.

methods.name: showEditorChangeAlert
methods.description: Displays an alert when changing editor types.
